about.title: The American Legend
about.paragraph1: The Ford Mustang is more than a car; it is a cultural icon that has defined generations of automotive enthusiasts. Since its launch in 1964, the Mustang has been synonymous with freedom, power, and the American spirit.
about.paragraph2: With seven generations of evolution, each Mustang GT represents the perfect combination of bold design, advanced engineering, and the unmistakable roar of a V8 engine.

generation.1.name: First Generation
generation.1.description: The Ford Mustang was introduced on April 17, 1964 at the New York World's Fair. It revolutionized the automotive industry by creating the compact and affordable sports car segment with bold design. Designed under the direction of Lee Iacocca, it sold over one million units in its first two years. It became a cultural icon of the 1960s, appearing in films like Bullitt. It offered engines ranging from a six-cylinder to a powerful 289 cubic inch V8.
generation.2.name: Second Generation (Mustang II)
generation.2.description: It responded to the 1973 oil crisis with a more compact and efficient design. Despite being smaller, it maintained the brand's sporty spirit. It won Motor Trend Car of the Year in 1974, proving that a Mustang could adapt to difficult times. Available as hatchback and fastback, it offered more efficient engines including a 302 cubic inch V8.
generation.3.name: Third Generation (Fox Body)
generation.3.description: Based on the Fox platform, it reintroduced performance with variants like the Mustang GT 5.0. It became an icon of 80s automotive culture. The Mustang SVO offered turbocharging for high-performance enthusiasts. The 5.0L V8 engine (302 cubic inches) is legendary for its sound and tunable power. This generation kept the Mustang legacy alive during a time of industry change.
generation.4.name: Fourth Generation
generation.4.description: It introduced a more rounded and modern design with sleek lines. The 1993 Mustang Cobra set new performance standards with its 320 horsepower V8. It included the iconic Mustang Mach 1 as a special edition. The Mustang SVT Cobra R became a track legend. This generation maintained the sporty essence while adapting to modern safety and emissions standards.
generation.5.name: Fifth Generation (Retro-Futuristic)
generation.5.description: It returned to its roots with a retro-futuristic design inspired by classic models. The 2005 Mustang GT marked the rebirth of the American automobile. The Mustang Shelby GT500 delivered over 500 horsepower, while the Mustang Boss 302 and Mustang Laguna Seca became track legends. This generation revived the spirit of the original Mustang with contemporary performance.
generation.6.name: Sixth Generation (S550)
generation.6.description: First generation with independent rear suspension, dramatically improving handling. The Mustang GT featured the 5.0L Coyote V8 engine with 435 horsepower, while the Mustang EcoBoost introduced turbocharged four-cylinder power. The Mustang Shelby GT350 and GT500 set new performance standards. Available globally for the first time in Mustang history.
generation.7.name: Seventh Generation (S650)
generation.7.description: The current generation combines modern technology with Mustang heritage. The 2024 Mustang GT features a 5.0L Coyote V8 with 480 horsepower. Interior features a 13.2-inch digital display and SYNC 4 system. The Mustang Dark Horse represents the ultimate expression of performance without being a Shelby. First Mustang with standard 6-speed manual transmission in the GT.
